prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Helium (헬륨) itself — the sovereign of the Helium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing. Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Her: a composed, dignified adult face; warm light beige skin; a softly rounded heart-shaped face, short midface, small rounded chin; large open ice-blue eyes with a level outer corner, softly arched brows, a small refined nose, muted rose lips and restrained peach eyeshadow. Slender and full-busted with a narrow waist. A long thick high braid with soft wispy fringe; pale peach-pink hair glowing softly like a gas-discharge tube.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes keep the shape described above at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Her element: the lightest noble gas: aloof and never reacting with anything, yet always lifting — balloons, airships, feet hovering just above the ground; first found not on Earth but in sunlight, as a single golden spectral line at the edge of an eclipsed sun; a gas-discharge tube glowing soft peach-pink; chilled near absolute zero it becomes a superfluid that creeps up the walls of its glass. Palette: pale peach-pink discharge glow, cloud white, high-altitude sky blue, a thin golden spectral line.

World and costume: a floor-length priestly vestment with gold-trimmed stoles and a tall airy head ornament sitting entirely above the hairline. Cloud-white silk with a sky-blue lining, peach-pink inner panels and fine golden edges; a deep neckline, open shoulders and a high side slit. The double-layered hem and stoles curl upward in smooth translucent wave-shaped silk ribs, built to resemble superfluid climbing a vessel wall. Slender white boots under the slit, a delicate gold gorget, open hands. No corset, no machinery.

Exposure: bold, deliberate deep neckline and bare shoulders or thighs as specified above; intimate areas covered. The costume remains properly worn and symmetrical.

Pose and setting: hovering a hand's breadth above a circular crystal temple floor, body in a gentle three-quarter turn, one empty hand raised palm-up and the other resting open beside her hip. Her calm eyes look slightly toward the viewer. A more intimate inner eclipse sanctuary with towering prismatic windows, a darkened sun visible between arches, thin golden spectrum light on the floor and a few drifting peach-pink lanterns.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (He) and atomic number (2) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
